## About This Project

Penguin Explorer is a portfolio project demonstrating end-to-end machine learning deployment skills in both **R** and **Python**.

### Technologies Used

#### Data & ML
- **pandas** / **dplyr**: Data manipulation
- **scikit-learn**: Model training
- **DuckDB**: Local analytical database
- **Vetiver**: Model versioning and deployment

#### Web Applications
- **Shiny for Python**: Reactive web application
- **Shiny for R**: Reactive web application
- **FastAPI**: REST API framework

#### DevOps
- **Docker**: Containerization
- **Docker Compose**: Multi-container orchestration
- **GitHub Actions**: CI/CD pipeline
- **Quarto**: Documentation website

### Dataset

This project uses the [Palmer Penguins](https://allisonhorst.github.io/palmerpenguins/) dataset, which contains measurements for three penguin species observed on islands in the Palmer Archipelago, Antarctica.

### Author

Built as part of the [DevOps for Data Science](https://do4ds.com/) curriculum.
